unit.why: A single anecdote: one Friday night in Mezeritch, the Maggid sent his attendant to tell R. Aharon of Karlin to stop reciting the Song of Songs, because his recitation was shaking the worlds; R. Hillel of Paritch then comments on it.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם (דס"ד ע"א) שבהיות החבירים ביחד
stories.end_quote: השינה של הרה״מ הי׳ יקר ביותר עיי״ש
stories.summary_en: On a Friday night in Mezeritch, R. Aharon of Karlin's ecstatic recitation of the Song of Songs shook the upper worlds and kept the Maggid awake, so the Maggid sent his attendant to stop him; R. Hillel of Paritch, retelling it in tears, drew from it the greatness of the Maggid.
